Nha Trang ca liet fish vermicelli soup
bun-sua-nha-trang.serving_basis: Four bowls of jellyfish vermicelli soup with ca liet fish, sea fish cake, clear broth and fresh greens.
bun-sua-nha-trang.description: Nha Trang jellyfish vermicelli soup has a clear broth made from ca liet fish, with picked fish meat, sea fish cake and crisp prepared jellyfish. Serve with fresh rice vermicelli, bean sprouts and herbs; offer fermented fish sauce, lime and chili on the side.
bun-sua-nha-trang.finished_dish: The clear broth is gently sweet from ca liet fish. Crisp jellyfish, picked fish and tender-chewy sea fish cake are served with vermicelli and fresh herbs.
bun-sua-nha-trang.serving: Place vermicelli, jellyfish, picked fish and sea fish cake in a bowl; pour over hot ca liet fish broth and add bean sprouts, scallions and cilantro. Serve fermented fish sauce, lime and chili separately.

nom-sua-do-hai-phong.serving: Arrange jellyfish and side dishes separately on a plate. Roll each portion with perilla leaves, marjoram or fig leaves, dip in shrimp paste mixed with vinegar; Clean up immediately after mixing.

bun-tom-hai-phong.description: Hai Phong shrimp vermicelli has a sweet clear broth from shrimp bones and heads, accompanied by stir-fried shrimp, wood ear mushrooms, celery, tomatoes and dill. Viet Kitchen compiles the right amount of spices for home meals; Keep both whole shrimp and minced shrimp so that the bowl of vermicelli has many layers of flavor.
bun-tom-hai-phong.finished_dish: The broth is fragrant with shrimp and has a mild taste; Firmly cooked shrimp, lightly crispy wood ear mushrooms and just-cooked celery.
bun-tom-hai-phong.serving: Blanch the noodles, place the shrimp and celery in a bowl and pour in the hot broth. Sprinkle with green onions, dill, and pepper; Serve lemon and chili separately.

goi-ca-trich-phu-quoc.description: Phu Quoc herring salad is a dish of lime fish rolled with rice paper with wild vegetables, star fruit, shredded coconut and peanuts, dipped in fish sauce mixed with garlic and chili. Viet Kitchen edits meals at home and adds instructions for choosing and keeping fish safely refrigerated; Lemon juice does not replace parasite control procedures for raw fish.
goi-ca-trich-phu-quoc.finished_dish: Cool fish with lemon flavor, lightly fatty shredded coconut, fragrant wild vegetables and sweet and sour fish sauce create a well-balanced salad.
goi-ca-trich-phu-quoc.serving: Place the fish pieces on coconut oil rice paper, add vegetables, star fruit, shredded coconut and roasted peanuts, roll up and dip in sweet and sour fish sauce. Serve the fish cold and eat immediately after mixing.
